title: Hoshino Ichika — Words Before Dawn〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello, Miku. Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, hello.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We've been expecting you. Where are the others?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's just me today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I see. How has band practice been going?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It's going great.
Though we've been pretty busy with school lately.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's actually why I came.
I wanted to let you know we're probably not going to have much time to visit for a while.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. We'll miss you guys, but school is important.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Make sure to come see us once your schedules open up again.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Of course.
Well, I'll see you two later.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder if something happened.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It didn't feel like it, but I'm still a little worried.
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Welcome back, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
How'd it go?
Did they suspect anything?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I don't think so.
I just told them we're going to be really busy for a while.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We shouldn't have anything to worry about, then.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright! Let's use the time to improve so we can really surprise them!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We can't keep forcing Miku and Luka to take the lead during our sessions like last time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Next time, I'd like to perform for them instead.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to show them how good we've become thanks to all their help and support!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I can't wait to surprise them with a great performance of our own!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Let's get to it, then.
Get ready for some tough practices.

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki, & Honami
rows.Line: Right!
Two weeks later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hm...
We've more or less got the hang of these songs...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I feel like we're still missing something.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree.
Something just feels off.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, but what exactly?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure. All I know is it doesn't have that same feeling of completeness as the time we performed with Miku and Luka.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Do you think we should play for them and get some advice?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What? Wouldn't that defeat the whole surprise?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I don't think so.
We'll still be showing them all the work we've been putting in!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And this way, we can get an honest assessment of whatever it is we're missing. That's how we improve!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's right. I think it's a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess you're right. I would have liked to perfect it on our own, but that's probably not the best use of our time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright! Let's go show them what we can do!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wh-What did you think?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That was amazing! You're really improving!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes.
That was wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Really?
Something still feels a little off, though.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I did sort of get that feeling.
Still, it really was a great performance.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I only wish you'd come to practice with us.
You could have improved even more.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh! We actually realized we've been relying on you too much. We wanted to show you we could do it on our own as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But now we're stuck here and can't quite figure out what we're missing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Though I hate to admit it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah... Miku, I realized something while the four of us were practicing. You and Luka always give us the best advice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to keep learning everything I can from you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
You finally realized how important a mentor is?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! We sure did!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku, Luka, would you mind practicing with us today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You getting fired up again, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think so.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Does that mean you're going to start coming around for practices again? Miku's been pretty lonely without you around.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: H-Hey! Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're all finished setting up. Let's do this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want to keep improving as well!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Alright, shall we get started, then?
Let's take it from the top.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right!
